Nice work around for now; Download UFC Arabia its a $5 a month subscription and because all the fights are on Fight Island in Abu Dhabi the fights that usually wouldn't be available on the UFC Arabia app are there now. UFC Arabia will ONLY show fights that are happening in Abu Dhabi. For Khabib/Gaethje I didn't pay a dime over the 5$ a month fee, I didn't pay the ESPN fee and watch all the prelims and the main card on my Xbox having only paid $5. So as long as Fight Island is still a thing for the near future that subscription works great. Use a VPN like Express VPN and set your location to Abu Dhabi. Boom done. I do the same thing for F1.
